activities.description: Presenter introduces the project, explaining its purpose as a low-cost alternative to commercially available collision carts.
Presenter discusses the limitations of commercial versions and the inspiration behind this project, mentioning a research group in Spain.
Presenter highlights the features of his collision cart, including the accelerometer, ultrasonic sensor, and photodiode, and their use in undergraduate physics experiments.
Presenter transitions to the next scene, stating he will demonstrate the cart's capabilities.

youtube_description:
A poorly done little project I've been working on, hopefully I'll be able to clean it up so it's actually usable. It's a 'collision cart' with a set a set of sensors including accelerometers, photodiodes, and ultrasonic rangefinders that send that data over Wifi/UDP to a python script that plots the data. 

Paper from Universidad de Val-ladolid
Open-source sensors system for doing simple physics experiments file:///C:/Users/ecalm/Downloads/scannas,+final410.pdf
https://github.com/percomp/OSHIWASP
My Fork of Their Project
https://github.com/ecalman/OSHIWASP
